threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still pause at the sound of the tube trains and look excited, while everyone else just keeps walking.
Last night on the 36, a guy sang an entire Adele song. No one clapped, but the bus driver kept smiling in the mirror.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I found a street market selling fresh dill and homemade hummus right next to a graffiti-covered wall. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you stumble upon a hidden techno party in an abandoned factory at 3 AM, complete with a DIY bar and an impromptu art installation.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If they know the difference between a 'burrito' and a 'Mission burrito,' they might be a local. Also, a true local knows to check BART delays before heading out.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy singing opera to the 38 Geary crowd while waiting for the bus. Everyone was annoyed until he hit a high note—then we clapped. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the quiet corners where local artists paint and the scent of fresh bread at 8 AM from the bakeries.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their hesitation at the subway turnstiles, looking for a ticket machine that doesn’t exist in the Raval.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check your watch for tube times instead of just walking to the bus stop. The 76 will get you there quicker anyway.
Caught the 37 last night, and a guy spent the whole journey showing off his pet snake. No one knew whether to be scared or impressed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw an old man feeding the pigeons at Tempelhofer Feld while a group of kids played soccer nearby, all under the watchful eye of a futuristic wind turbine.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand with vegan options at 3 AM, complete with a side of techno beats from the nearest club.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name the BART station that got shut down last week just by the sound of a train braking.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 27 bus, singing opera. Only in SF does evening wear mean you can serenade your fellow commuters.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into the Pl. de la Vila de Gràcia for a quiet coffee, but locals often pack the place, making it loud and lively.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to navigate the Mercat de l'Abaceria's winding aisles without stopping to take a photo of every stall.
